response.overview: Experience the magic of classic fairy tales with this DVD collection of 20 stories from Scholastic. Perfect for children and families, this collection features beloved characters and enchanting adventures that will transport you to a world of wonder. Whether you're a fan of animation or simply looking for a fun and educational addition to your movie collection, this set is sure to delight.  With stories from renowned authors and illustrators, this DVD set is a must-have for any fan of fairy tales. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this classic collection to your library today.
response.title: Storybook Treasures: 20 Fairy Tales
